summary: Occupant Classification System (OCS) strain-gauge sensor harness may experience terminal fretting or calibration shift under seat track adjustment, setting DTC B00A0 and suppressing passenger airbag deployment.
consequence: Failure to detect adult passenger weight may disable passenger frontal airbag, increasing the risk of injury during a collision.
corrective_action: Dealership technicians will inspect passenger seat wiring harness, re-pin connector terminals with gold-plated contacts, and perform zero-point mass calibration per USER-MANUAL-01.

summary: Spencer Manufacturing, Inc. (Spencer) is recalling certain 2026 Rescue, 2025 Initial Attack, and 2024-2025 Pumper emergency vehicles. The display may stop responding to touch commands or fail to power on, preventing the activation of exterior emergency lights, fire fighting and other emergency equipment.
consequence: A loss of exterior lights can reduce the visibility of the vehicle to other drivers, increasing the risk of a crash. Inoperative equipment can delay emergency response, increasing the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Spencer will work with Hale Products to update the firmware and install a monitor system, free of charge. Owner notification letters were mailed July 21, 2026. Owners may contact customer service at 1-269-637-8721.

component: Air Bags & Seat Belt Pretensioners May Not Deploy in a Crash
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2019-2022 Veloster N, 2019-2023 Kona Electric vehicles. A software error in the air bag control unit (ACU) may improperly deactivate the air bag system and seat belt pretensioners.
consequence: Air bags and seat belt pretensioners that do not activate in a crash increases the risk of injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the ACU software,  free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed January 1, 2027. Owners may contact Hyundai customer service at 1-855-371-9460. Hyundai's number for this recall is 311. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will become searchable on NHTSA.gov on November 6, 2026.

component: Hill Start Assist Message Incorrectly Enabled
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Medium-Duty Electric (MDe) vehicles that were incorrectly manufactured with the hill start assist (HSA) message enabled.
consequence: A false hill start assist message can lead to unexpected vehicle rollback on an incline, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will update the dashboard notification software and add a correction to the owner's manual, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 28, 2026. Owners may contact Mack's customer service at 1-800-866-1177. Mack's number for this recall is SC0502. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 5, 2026.

component: Improperly Tightened Steering Gear Assembly Nut
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025-2026 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vehicles. The steering gear assembly may have a nut that was not properly tightened.
consequence: A loose nut that separates from the steering gear assembly while driving can cause a loss of steering control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect the serial number and replace the steering gear assembly, if necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact GMC customer service at 1-888-988-7267 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262579350. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026. Vehicles that were not properly inspected under recall 26V399 will need to be re-inspected under 26V718.

summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023–2027 Cadillac LYRIQ, 2025–2026 model year Cadillac CELESTIQ, 2024–2027 Chevrolet Blazer EV, and 2026-2027 Cadillac VISTIQ vehicles. The brake system control module (BSCM) contains a software defect that may cause a loss of braking during certain driving conditions.
consequence: A loss of braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: The BSCM software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262570900. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026.

summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain Meritor drivelines with model numbers RPL20, RPL25, RPL10, RPL35, RPL14, and 176MXL. The drivelines may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, causing the bearing cup to separate from the driveline.
consequence: A driveline separation can cause a loss of drive power, increasing the risk of a crash. Detached components can become a road hazard for other vehicles, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and replace the driveline as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 20, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. Cummins number for this recall is AFT26001.

summary: Foreign Tire Sales, Inc (Foreign Tire) is recalling certain Otani tires, size 235/65R-16(C). The tire tread may separate. As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."
consequence: Tread separation may cause a loss of vehicle control, increasing the risk of a crash.
corrective_action: Foreign Tire will replace the tires, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed beginning November 2, 2026. Owners may contact Foreign Tire’s customer service at 1-908-687-0559.

summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2027 Pause travel trailers. The fireplace installed may have incorrect clearance from the cabinet.
consequence: Incorrect fireplace clearance increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action: Dealers will install a spacer for proper clearance between the fireplace and cabinet, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 7, 2026. Owners may contact Forest River customer service at 1-574-535-2748. Forest River's number for this recall is 426-2113.

component: Seating Power Cord May Have Inadequate Circuit Protection
summary: Ember Recreational Vehicles, INC (Ember) is recalling certain 2024 E-Series travel trailers equipped with certain power seating assemblies. The power cord fuse may not provide adequate circuit protection.
consequence: In the event of a short circuit, inadequate protection increases the risk of a fire.
corrective_action:
Dealers will replace the power cord, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 23, 2026. Owners may contact Ember customer service at 1-844-732-4204.
.

summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain Cummins Power Generation Trailer-Mounted Generator Sets with model numbers C275D2RE, C200D2RE, C150D2RE, and C100D2RE. The bolted connections attaching the leads to the voltage selector switch may have been improperly tightened, allowing the fasteners to loosen.
consequence: A loose voltage selector switch connection can lead to a short circuit or increased heat, increasing the risk of electrical shock or a burn injury.
corrective_action: Dealers will inspect and properly tighten the fasteners, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 25, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467. Cummins number for this recall is 5849.
